SSC Stenographer C, D 2025 First Round of Tentative Allocation (FRTA) 2026 - Complete Details

Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has Officially Released Notification for Option Cum Preference Form for the Post of Stenographer Grade C and Grade D Recruitment Examination 2025. Skill Test Exam held on  January 28-29,2026,  Skill Test Admit Card On  January 20, 2026 &. All Interested Candidates Can Option Cum Preference Notice Now in The Given Link Below..

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start On : 06 June 2025
  • Registration Last Date :  26 June 2025 (11:00 PM)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 June 2025 (11:00 PM)
  • Correction Date : 01-02 July 2025
  • Exam City Details : 31 July 2025
  • Admit Card : August 2025
  • CBT Exam Date : 06, 07 & 08 August 2025
  • Answer Key : 22 August 2025
  • Result Declared : 28 November 2025
  • Skill Test Exam City: 20 January 2026
  • Skill Test Date : 28, 29 January 2026
  • Option Form Available : 05-08 May 2026

Application Fee

  • General / OBC Candidates :Rs.100/-
  • SC / ST/ PH/ Female Candidates :Rs. 00/-
  • Payment Mode: Pay The Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking Fee Mode.
